name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatCreateBySelfActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this form when a user chooses to create a QChat server or announcement server. The user enters a name and selects an icon; the SDK creates the server and its initial channel.
disableEffect: Users cannot create a QChat server or announcement server through the built-in flow.
